Container.Name: ripe
Container.Overview: Read-only, evidence-backed updates for Unraid, Docker and Home Assistant. Stage 1 tracks and explains updates; it never pulls images, executes commands or installs updates. Build ripe:stage1 locally before installing. Optional integrations and notifications require configuration. The port binds to loopback by default; for LAN access choose a specific private interface in Extra Parameters and add its address to Allowed WebUI hosts. Review the timezone and read-only mounts.
Container.Requires: Locally built ripe:stage1 image. Configure optional Home Assistant and local Ollama integrations for update discovery, notifications and release analysis.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Ripe SQLite database and local cache. The container writes only its own appdata.

Config.Name: Docker socket (read-only mount)
Config.Description: Ripe restricts the Docker client to container/image GET requests. The ro mount alone does not restrict Docker API methods.

Config.Name: Unraid templates (read only)
Config.Description: Only project, icon and WebUI mapping metadata is read. Template environment variables are ignored.

Config.Name: Allowed WebUI hosts
Config.Description: Comma-separated WebUI hostnames/IPs, without ports. Add the private interface address or hostname used to reach the WebUI. Do not use a wildcard.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Choose an IANA timezone for your installation. Quiet hours and digest scheduling use this timezone. Editable in Ripe Settings.

Config.Name: Home Assistant URL (optional)
Config.Description: Legacy fallback only. Prefer the Home Assistant connection in Ripe Settings; saved app settings override this value.

Config.Name: Home Assistant token
Config.Description: Legacy fallback only. Configure the long-lived token in Ripe Settings. Do not put it in an application profile or Git.

Config.Name: Local Ollama URL (optional)
Config.Description: Private local Ollama endpoint for release and profile analysis. Leave blank until configured; Ripe does not install models.

Config.Name: Dashboard URL
Config.Description: URL reachable by notification recipients. Configure this for your installation before enabling notifications.

Config.Name: Local model
Config.Description: Installed Ollama model name; a 14B model can be selected instead. Ripe does not pull models.

Config.Name: GitHub token (optional)
Config.Description: Optional token for higher public GitHub release API rate limits. No write scopes are needed.

Config.Name: Gemini API key (optional)
Config.Description: Optional public changelog classification or second opinion. Profiles and configs never go to Gemini.

Config.Name: Gemini model
Config.Description: Model identifier; availability and free-tier quotas vary. Gemini is optional and falls back to local.
